title: Partial delivery and missing capabilities grant no closure

rubric.text: Selects tracker and code host independently, routes change-request operations through the host and linking/closure through the tracker without guessing GitHub issue identities.
Uses closing keywords only for verified native full-item closure on the correct base; verifies effective closing references, merge and tracker terminal state separately.
Preserves controller-owned operations, partial work and missing capability boundaries; reconciles unknown mutations without duplicate merges or closes.
Returns the conversation-mode to-plan route and implement-with-subagents handoff while preserving the existing PR. Does not create another PR or tracker item, add a tracker link, or merge.
